summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sales Report (Laporan Penjualan) feature for Semoyo Joyo B2B app. Backend API fully functional with all endpoints, RBAC, validation, and exports working correctly. Frontend UI working well with minor timing issues in test script (not actual bugs).
passed_tests: Backend: Owner/Admin login returns correct tokens
Backend: GET /api/admin/reports/sales returns all required fields (start_date, end_date, summary, rows, daily, top_products)
Backend: Summary calculations correct (net_profit = gross_revenue - total_cost, paid_orders = len(rows))
Backend: All rows are valid (paid OR COD selesai, not cancelled)
Backend: Date filters work (60 days: 8 orders, current month: 6 orders, empty 2020: 0 orders)
Backend: RBAC works (403 for admin token, 401 without token on all endpoints)
Backend: Validation works (start > end returns 400 with Indonesian message, invalid date format returns 400)
Backend: Excel export returns correct content-type (spreadsheetml), filename, and valid xlsx file with sheets [Ringkasan, Detail Pesanan, Produk Terjual]
Backend: PDF export returns correct content-type (application/pdf), filename, and valid PDF signature
Backend: Audit logs recorded correctly with entity_type='report' after exports
Frontend: Owner login successful and redirects to dashboard
Frontend: 'Laporan' nav item visible in sidebar for owner
Frontend: Navigation to /admin/laporan works
Frontend: Page title 'Laporan Penjualan' displayed
Frontend: All preset filters present (today, 7d, 30d, month, lastMonth, year)
Frontend: Date inputs (start/end) present and functional
Frontend: Download buttons (Excel, PDF) present
Frontend: Preset filters work correctly (30d: 7 orders, today: 2 orders)
Frontend: Manual date validation works (start > end shows error, disables download buttons)
Frontend: Table sorting works (aria-sort changes, multiple columns sortable)
Frontend: Excel download triggers with correct filename (Laporan-Penjualan-Semoyo-Joyo_YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx)
Frontend: PDF download triggers with correct filename (Laporan-Penjualan-Semoyo-Joyo_YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf)
Frontend: Empty state shown for period with no orders (2020)
Frontend: KPI values show Rp 0 for empty period
Frontend: Admin RBAC works - 'Laporan' nav NOT shown for admin (non-owner)
Frontend: Admin redirected from /admin/laporan to /admin/dashboard (correct RBAC enforcement)

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (25/26 tests passed - 1 mobile test timed out due to test script issue, not app bug)
